styles.css: /* wp-ja-fresco: one look in both schemes (D-01). The source (JA Fresco, Joomla 6 T4) has a single dark look: no data-theme, no dark sheet, no switch; measured in all four variants, dark = light on every rule. The light-dark() wiring of the base theme is kept (invariant 4) with both halves equal, so the tracy_theme cookie and data-theme still work and change nothing visible. Values: tokens.css (measured 21/10 on :8401). */ :root{color-scheme:light dark;--jf-accent:var(--ds-c-accent, #e6c9a2);--wp--preset--color--bg:light-dark(var(--ds-c-bg, #0a0b0a),var(--ds-c-bg, #0a0b0a));--wp--preset--color--surface:light-dark(var(--ds-c-surface, #1b1a1c),var(--ds-c-surface, #1b1a1c));--wp--preset--color--surface-warm:light-dark(var(--ds-c-ink, #1a191b),var(--ds-c-ink, #1a191b));--wp--preset--color--fg:light-dark(var(--ds-c-fg, #ffffffcc),var(--ds-c-fg, #ffffffcc));--wp--preset--color--fg-2:light-dark(var(--ds-c-heading, #ffffff),var(--ds-c-heading, #ffffff));--wp--preset--color--muted:light-dark(var(--ds-c-muted, #ffffffcc),var(--ds-c-muted, #ffffffcc));--wp--preset--color--border:light-dark(var(--ds-c-border, #ffffff12),var(--ds-c-border, #ffffff12));--wp--preset--color--border-soft:light-dark(var(--ds-c-border-soft, #ffffff12),var(--ds-c-border-soft, #ffffff12));--wp--preset--color--accent:light-dark(var(--ds-c-accent, #e6c9a2),var(--ds-c-accent, #e6c9a2));--wp--preset--color--accent-on:light-dark(var(--ds-c-accent-on, #0a0b0a),var(--ds-c-accent-on, #0a0b0a));--wp--preset--color--accent-hover:light-dark(var(--ds-c-accent-hover, #e6c9a2),var(--ds-c-accent-hover, #e6c9a2));--wp--preset--color--accent-active:light-dark(var(--ds-c-accent-active, #e6c9a2),var(--ds-c-accent-active, #e6c9a2));}:root[data-theme="light"]{color-scheme:light}:root[data-theme="dark"]{color-scheme:dark}
